description: an old king of winter with white hair and a white beard, an ice crown, a long dark blue coat with white frost embroidery, a white fur mantle with ice pauldrons, dark boots, a tall staff topped with a big ice crystal held upright in his right hand, his left hand empty, no sword, no other weapon, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
how to hold the staff: upright in the front hand, the other hand empty, seen from the side; only the staff's hold, not this figure's look
